instruction: Candid documentary medium shot of a cozy indoor living room. On a yellow couch, the person with short curly hair and glasses (R1) sits on the right, gesturing with their right hand while speaking and looking at R2. On the left, the person with short dark hair in the green sweatshirt (R2) holds a document and looks back at R1, listening attentively. They sit side-by-side over a wooden coffee table in the foreground holding a laptop and a cup of black coffee. Warm, soft indoor lighting illuminates the scene with natural tones.
